hypothesis: In prospective NPB full-game markets, officially confirmed starting-pitcher changes received by T-30 may improve forecasts over the same-time market and an otherwise identical no-fact model.
unit: unique official game ID and exact product/period/line/settlement version; doubleheaders require official game IDs
eligibility: Unique official game and player IDs, actual receipt by decision <= start-30m, full simultaneous product odds and receipt, official outcome and product-specific settlement. Changed games require timestamped original official documents confirming before and after starter; unchanged games require official confirmation of the same starter by T-30 and a prior official expected-starter record. Probable is not confirmed participation. Missing or ambiguous is excluded with reason.
covariates: market implied probabilities normalized within exact product
home/away starter change indicators and pre-decision historical starter metrics
home/away bullpen prior 24h and 48h workload from completed available boxscores
confirmed lineup availability if actually received by decision, otherwise missing indicator
model: One predeclared regularized multinomial logistic correction to same-time market log probabilities, with fixed L2=10, trained only on earlier eligible games; no manual probability bonuses. Draw is modeled only when product has a draw outcome. Product classes and settlement remain separate.
split_and_selection: After this commit, use newly received prospective events only. Chronological first 60% train, next 20% validation, final 20% holdout by whole game date. Freeze cutoffs before outcome access. No hyperparameter tuning; validation assesses availability and numerical stability, not candidate selection. One fixed candidate versus market and no-fact baseline; no refit after holdout inspection. A separately preserved exact operating frozen pick is compared only on the matching subset.
stop_rules: Do not fit until at least 200 eligible distinct games, including at least 50 verified starter changes, with at least 30 holdout games and both changed and unchanged games in train and holdout. If missing outcome classes, ambiguous settlement or failed leakage checks, stop as blocked_data. These are feasibility thresholds, not power or profitability guarantees. Never adjust thresholds after results.
evaluation: For each product and common-coverage cohort, report opportunity and exclusion counts, coverage, accuracy, unit ROI, multiclass log loss, Brier, daily close maximum drawdown; explicitly handle voids and pushes according to the archived product rules. Report paired market differences and date-block uncertainty; no automatic promotion. No candidate performance claimed unless independent holdout is actually available.
safety: No target-game pitches, future labels, publication-time-as-receipt, reconstructed operating picks, unverified document hash, inferred player identity, cross-game doubleheader join or synthetic earlier prices. Tests must poison future labels and late facts and detect duplicate original document bytes. No live system changes.
